verdict.rationale: dlt's core interface is a documented Python API (dlt.pipeline, pipeline.run, pipeline.dataset(), resource/source decorators) with extensive tutorials and reference docs, plus a documented CLI and even an official MCP server for agent-driven pipeline management, making it fully drivable programmatically by AI-native users. Missing for 10: no formal OpenAPI/REST API specification was found (probe returned 404s for all openapi.json candidates), and no independent hands-on confirmation of API completeness beyond vendor docs.
